## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle parallel translation of the *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya-dhāraṇī-sūtra* by the Táng lay translator **Dù Xíngyǐ** ([杜行顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%9C%E8%A1%8C%E9%A1%97)) at Cháng'ān in **679 CE** (Yífèng 4 / 1st month) — preceding Buddhapāli's translation ([KR6j0144](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0144)) by four years. The translation was a collaborative work involving the Indian *bhikṣu* **Dùpó** ([度婆](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BA%A6%E5%A9%86)) and the Tripiṭaka-master **Divākara** ([地婆訶羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%B0%E5%A9%86%E8%A8%B6%E7%BE%85)) as Sanskrit-verifier.

**Abstract**

The Dù Xíngyǐ recension is the **earliest** of the four Táng Chinese translations of the *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya-dhāraṇī-sūtra*. According to the *Kāiyuán shìjiào lù* ([KR6s0093](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0093)), the work was undertaken by imperial decree of Emperor Gāozōng after Buddhapāli had presented the Sanskrit manuscript at the imperial court. The Dù Xíngyǐ recension and the later Buddhapāli recension (T967) are the two principal early Táng witnesses; the later Divākara translations (T969 = [KR6j0146](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0146), T970 = [KR6j0147](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0147)) and Yìjìng's translation (T971 = [KR6j0148](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0148)) round out the Táng witnesses.

The translation date is **Yífèng 4 = 679 CE**.
